data.label: Homepage Checklist
data.title:
5 website essentials that
*stop losing leads*
data.sub: Swipe to check your own site →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: A clear *value proposition*
data.body: Your visitors should know exactly what you do within three seconds. If they have to guess, they will leave and find a competitor instead.
data.fix: Fix: Add a one-sentence headline stating your service and location.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: A *clickable* phone number
data.body: Most customers are on their phones. If they can’t tap your number to call immediately, they will give up.
data.fix: Fix: Place your phone number in the top right corner.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: A *direct* call-to-action
data.body: Don't make customers hunt for a way to hire you. Give them one clear button to book or request a quote.
data.fix: Fix: Add a high-contrast 'Get a Quote' button above the fold.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Professional *quality photos*
data.body: Stock photos look generic and untrustworthy. Real photos of your team or work prove you are a legitimate local business.
data.fix: Fix: Replace generic stock images with real photos of your work.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Your *service area*
data.body: People need to know if you actually serve their neighborhood. Clearly stating your location saves everyone time.
data.fix: Fix: List your primary service cities in the header text.
